landing.headline: Pick your favourite. Give what it's worth. See where it stands.
landing.subheader: Expressions of joy, for charitable causes, in the name of those we love.
landing.cta.caption: Free to create · 100% goes to charity
landing.how.arrive.label: Open the favpoll
landing.how.arrive.body: A QR code or a link opens the favpoll — the topic, the charity it supports, and the standings still to come.
landing.how.pick.label: Pick your favourite
landing.how.pick.body: Every favpoll asks one question — favourite biscuit, favourite song, favourite colour. Guests answer with their own.
landing.how.pledge.label: Pledge its worth
landing.how.pledge.body: Guests give what their favourite is worth to them. Every pledge goes to the favpoll's charity in full — favpoll takes no fee.
landing.how.reveal.label: Reveal its standing
landing.how.reveal.body: Pledging shows where your favourite stands — live rankings that move with every pledge.
landing.record.principle: Every pledge makes an eternal mark by feeding the record — all-time rankings for favpoll topics.
memorials.headline: Remember them by what they loved. Give in their name.
memorials.subheader: A favpoll gathers everyone around their favourite things — their music, their seaside town, their dog breed — and turns the answers into pledges to a charity the family names.
memorials.how.title: How it works
memorials.how.pick.label: Pick
memorials.how.pick.body: The family picks the question — favourite song, favourite flower, favourite walk — and every guest answers with their own.
memorials.how.pledge.label: Pledge
memorials.how.pledge.body: Each guest pledges what their favourite is worth. Every penny goes to a registered charity the family names.
memorials.how.reveal.label: Reveal
memorials.how.reveal.body: After pledging, the standings are revealed — and if the family adds one, a reveal of their loved one's own favourite. A quote, a memory, one final word — a keepsake, not a quiz.
memorials.wake.title: Made for the wake
memorials.wake.body: The service isn't the moment — the wake is. Printed table cards with a QR code sit quietly beside the sandwiches; guests take part from their own phones, in their own time. A line on the order of service reaches those who can't stay.
memorials.wake.nocash: Nobody carries cash any more. The collection plate has become a QR code — favpoll gives it warmth.
memorials.presence.title: As quiet or as present as the family wants
memorials.presence.ambient: Just the table cards — guests interact privately, nothing on show.
memorials.presence.screen: A screen in the corner — the tribute view puts the person first, with the giving kept quiet.
memorials.presence.rally: Or a fundraiser in their name — the total ticking up as the room takes part.
memorials.assure.free.label: Free to set up
memorials.assure.free.body: No fees taken from the family or the gift.
memorials.assure.charity.label: 100% to charity
memorials.assure.charity.body: Pledges go to a registered charity, always.
memorials.assure.nofave.label: No favourite needed
memorials.assure.nofave.body: Guests without a pick can still give to the shared fund.
memorials.assure.phone.label: No app to install
memorials.assure.phone.body: Works in the browser on any phone, from a QR code.
memorials.pro.title: Celebrant, funeral director, or hospice?
memorials.pro.body: If you help families plan farewells, we'd love to make favpoll useful to you — printed packs, examples to share, and nothing to sell.
memorials.close.headline: In their honour, by their favourites.
celebrations.headline: Make their day about what they love. Give in their name.
celebrations.subheader: Birthdays, retirements, weddings — a favpoll gathers everyone around the guest of honour's favourite things, and turns the fun into pledges to a charity they choose.
celebrations.how.title: How it works
celebrations.how.pick.label: Pick
celebrations.how.pick.body: Pick one topic — favourite film, favourite holiday, favourite biscuit — and guests each back their own favourite.
celebrations.how.pledge.label: Pledge
celebrations.how.pledge.body: Each guest pledges what their favourite is worth. Every penny goes to a registered charity the guest of honour cares about.
celebrations.how.reveal.label: Reveal
celebrations.how.reveal.body: After pledging, the standings are revealed — and the guest of honour's own favourite with them. Will the room have called it?
celebrations.moment.title: A moment, not a chore
celebrations.moment.body: Share the QR code with the invitation, on the tables, or up on a screen. The reveal makes a natural beat in the speeches — then the party carries on.
celebrations.moment.line: It's a present everyone clubs together for — except the present is a donation, and the wrapping is a game.
celebrations.presence.title: From party game to centrepiece
celebrations.presence.ambient: Cards on the tables — guests play along between courses.
celebrations.presence.screen: The live standings on a screen — a horse race the whole room can watch.
celebrations.presence.rally: A goal to chase in their honour — the total ticking up all night.
celebrations.close.headline: For their big day, by their favourites.
fundraisers.headline: Fundraising with a favourite question. Every penny reaches the charity.
fundraisers.subheader: A favpoll gives your supporters something to play for — everyone backs their favourite, and the room watches the total climb.
fundraisers.how.title: How it works
fundraisers.how.pick.label: Pick
fundraisers.how.pick.body: Pick a topic your crowd will argue about — favourite comedian, favourite biscuit, favourite local landmark.
fundraisers.how.pledge.label: Pledge
fundraisers.how.pledge.body: Supporters pledge what their favourite is worth. Every penny goes to your registered charity — favpoll takes nothing.
fundraisers.how.reveal.label: Watch
fundraisers.how.reveal.body: The standings are revealed as pledges land, and the live display turns your event into a telethon — the total edging toward the goal in front of the room.
fundraisers.rally.title: Built for the room
fundraisers.rally.body: Set a pledge goal and put the live display on the big screen: the total, the progress bar, and a QR code either side that guests can scan from their seats. Quiz nights, galas, coffee mornings, telethons.
fundraisers.rally.line: People give more when giving is something to take part in — a pick, a rivalry, a race to the goal.
fundraisers.presence.title: Works at any size
fundraisers.presence.ambient: A table stand and a QR code at the bake sale.
fundraisers.presence.screen: The live display at the quiz night — standings between rounds.
fundraisers.presence.rally: The full telethon — goal on screen, guest wall scrolling, total climbing.
fundraisers.close.headline: For your cause, by their favourites.
